tasks.title: SEC-5+SEC-8: Fix session_dna.json VCS exposure and audit session ID correlation
tasks.description: session_dna.json defaults to the project root where it can be committed to VCS. Audit log entries use a new random UUID per-call instead of the real session ID.
tasks.details: Fix 1 (DNA path): In src/session/dna.rs L39, change the project-local path from session_dna.json to .grok/session_dna.json. Update SessionDna::load() to check .grok/session_dna.json before the global path. Fix 2 (session ID): Add session_id: String to ToolContext in src/tools/tool_context.rs and thread it through all tool call sites. Remove Uuid::new_v4() calls in file_tools.rs L42 and L65 in favor of ctx.session_id so all audit entries for a session share one correlatable ID.
tasks.testStrategy: Fix 1: SessionDna::load() picks up .grok/session_dna.json when present; bare session_dna.json in root is ignored. Fix 2: Two consecutive read_file calls on the same path produce audit log entries with identical session_id values.

tasks.title: COR-5: Implement or remove RateLimitConfig enforcement
tasks.description: RateLimitConfig is configurable in config.toml and shown in Config::show, but with_rate_limits() is an admitted no-op. Users configuring rate limits receive no protection.
tasks.details: Option A (implement): Check src/utils/rate_limiter.rs for an existing implementation. Integrate a token-bucket limiter into the GrokClient send path or ACP tool loop, tracking tokens-per-minute and requests-per-minute against RateLimitConfig values. Return a descriptive Err when limits are exceeded. Option B (remove): Remove RateLimitConfig from Config, remove with_rate_limits() from GrokClient, remove the rate_limits section from config.example.toml, and update CHANGELOG. Do not leave documented features that are admitted no-ops.
tasks.testStrategy: Option A: A unit test sends N+1 requests where N is the per-minute limit and asserts the (N+1)th returns a rate-limit error. Option B: cargo build succeeds with no references to RateLimitConfig remaining.

tasks.title: COR-6: Remove unused _timeout_secs parameter from run_shell_command
tasks.description: run_shell_command has a public _timeout_secs parameter suppressed with an underscore prefix that is never used. The function derives timeout from SecurityPolicy internally.
tasks.details: In src/tools/shell_tools.rs, remove the _timeout_secs: u64 parameter from run_shell_command. Update all call sites in registry.rs and elsewhere that pass this argument. The effective_timeout(security) function already provides the correct value from config or env. Run cargo clippy -- -D warnings to verify zero dead-parameter warnings remain.
tasks.testStrategy: cargo build with zero warnings. cargo clippy -- -D warnings passes. All existing shell_tools tests pass unchanged without the parameter.

tasks.title: TEST-2: Add integration test for tool dispatch round-trip
tasks.description: The critical path execute_tool to tool_arbitration to actual tool function has no end-to-end test. A regression anywhere in this chain would go undetected until runtime.
tasks.details: Add a tokio::test in tests/ or src/tools/registry.rs that: (1) Builds a ToolContext with a SecurityPolicy backed by tempfile::TempDir, (2) calls execute_tool write_file and asserts the file was created, (3) calls execute_tool read_file and asserts content matches, (4) calls execute_tool with unknown_tool and asserts Err is returned, (5) calls execute_tool with a known tool but missing required arg and asserts Err is returned with a message about missing fields.
tasks.testStrategy: cargo test includes the new integration tests and they pass. Tests use TempDir with no writes to the real filesystem. Tests run without a live network or API connection.
